gripOrHq.title: Team Restructuring
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add one advancement counter to each of up to two installed cards that can be advanced.

gripOrHq.title: Falsified-Transactions Expert
gripOrHq.rulesText: Move up to three advancement counters from one card to another installed card that can be advanced.

gripOrHq.title: Management Shake-Up
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add three advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

gripOrHq.title: Ball and Chain
gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner must pay [2] when encountering a piece of ice, in addition to any other costs, or end the run.

discardCards.title: Security Code WORM Chip
discardCards.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Trash a piece of unrezzed ice.

discardCards.title: Highlighter
discardCards.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Highlighter counter. Each Highlighter counter after the first allows you to access an additional card from R&D whenever you access cards from R&D. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

discardCards.title: Inside Job
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

discardCards.title: Viral Pipeline
discardCards.rulesText: After each successful run on Archives, HQ, or R&D, put a Socket counter in that data fort. Socket counter from Archives, Socket counter from HQ, and Socket counter from R&D: Give the Corp a Pipe counter. Each Pipe counter causes the Corp to forgo an action at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

discardCards.title: Mantis, Fixer-at-Large
discardCards.rulesText: Search your stack for a card, and bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Coup
scoreArea.rulesText:
Put [15] from the bank on Corporate Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Corporate Coup, if it has any bits.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: Highlighter
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Highlighter counter. Each Highlighter counter after the first allows you to access an additional card from R&D whenever you access cards from R&D. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

ice.title: Code Corpse
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

ice.title: D'Arc Knight
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Omni Kismet, Ph.D.
root.rulesText: Swap a piece of unrezzed ice on this fort with an ice card stored in HQ. The new ice card comes into play concealed. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

ice.title: Banpei
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.

ice.title: Ball and Chain
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner must pay [2] when encountering a piece of ice, in addition to any other costs, or end the run.

root.title: Department of Truth Enhancement
root.rulesText: A: Put [3] from the bank on Department of Truth Enhancement. A: Take all the bits from Department of Truth Enhancement.

ice.title: Haunting Inquisition
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Runner cannot make another run during his or her next six actions.
[Subroutine] End the run.
